decisions.reason: Presented as a flagship of the firm's sustainability direction, the citrus crate carries high visible commitment, so dropping it after one year would expose the decision and write off development investment.
A multi-model foldable container line with its own page represents substantial tooling investment and visible commitment, and early results can still be attributed to market ramp-up.
Several models of stackable crates mean sunk mould investment in a core category, so management will persist despite only modest website prominence.
The rackable pallet line fits the core pallet business and involves several models of tooling, making withdrawal after one year unlikely.
A dedicated page and a multi-model line signal commitment to the spill-retention pallets, and their niche industrial use justifies patience.
This is a single product with lower investment, but its dedicated page and short time on the market leave room to attribute any weak results to temporary causes.
